We are world shapers

We seek out challenges so we can create change. We question the status quo, and then innovate on it. We collaborate and integrate. We overcome barriers so our ideas can collide and grow.

Our Story

Study at the U of A

We are a Top 4 Canadian university and one of the Top 100 in the world. Find out what makes our student experience so rich, meaningful and life-changing. Explore our digital viewbook »

Undergraduate Studies

Your journey starts here. Choose from more than 200 program options, check the admission requirements and apply online.

Search Programs
Begin Application

Graduate Studies

More than 500 graduate programs, 250 specializations and 300 research areas — find out how to take your education to the next level.

Search Programs
Begin Application

Continuing Education

Grow your career part-time or online with our 200+ courses and 40+ programs.

Search Programs
Search Courses

Connect with the U of A

Whether you’d like to partner with researchers, attend an event, enjoy our facilities, or engage with the ideas shaping our world, there’s a place for you here.

Get connected

Indigenous Initiatives

Explore this portal to learn about inspiring Indigenous-led work in the teaching, learning, research and community engagement spaces of the university.

Learn More

Our Campuses The University of Alberta is a busy place — over 47,000 students at six separate campus locations. Learn about each of the unique campuses that make up the fifth largest university in Canada.

Visit our Campuses

The University of Alberta is located in one of the northernmost major cities in the world. Edmonton is a city with one million residents and one of Canada’s strongest local economies.

Like the university, Edmonton is a place where people come together to build, create and change things for the better. It is a place where good ideas have a strong chance to become reality.

What's Happening at the U of A

Discover what’s happening on campus and beyond. From world-class guest lectures to student-led festivals, find your next great experience.

Explore Events
